summary: No new role cleared every hard gate on November 1. Four postings were examined. Three are near-misses. Mirakl’s Principal AI Engineer (Paris, four office days a week, AI-agent systems for internal business domains) publishes a €90,000–€100,000 package with no equity, which fails the pay rule. Kpler’s Senior AI Engineer (AI Enablement) and Nebius’s Senior ML Engineer (Agentic Search) are clearly AI-central but publish no salary, and neither states an attendance rule or France eligibility. Supabase’s new AI Tooling Infrastructure role was rejected because the employer describes it as an infrastructure role rather than a product AI role. Earlier picks and near-misses that are unchanged are not repeated. These entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 1: 132 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. The sweep screened AI-titled roles on reachable boards, Paris- or France-located engineering roles with published pay on reachable Ashby boards, Greenhouse and Lever data for 111 France-located engineering roles (31 with pay text), and Ashby engineering roles first published since October 30 with a France or Europe-remote location. Compared with October 31, it surfaced one new AI-titled requisition (Supabase). A second pass reached 43 of 300 attempted aliases, a Workable and Recruitee check reached 6 of 44, and a pass over 105 additional company names reached 50 of 315 attempted board aliases (adding the Nebius board). Nine web searches were used for discovery only; leads found there were checked on employer boards, which added the Mirakl Labs Greenhouse board and Kpler’s Lever board. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 1, 2026. Posting dates come from employer ATS metadata.
Unpublished pay is recorded as unknown, not as below the threshold. Mirakl’s published package is a numeric figure that fails the rule; Kpler, Nebius and Supabase publish no salary.

GitGuardian’s Senior Software Engineer, AI and Remanence’s Member of Technical Staff (October 31 near-misses) are unchanged: still listed, still no published salary. They stay in the October 31 archive and are not repeated.
Earlier picks and near-misses that remain listed with unchanged terms, including Inato, Pigment, Qonto and Shift Technology, stay in their original archives and are not counted today.

Search-result leads not confirmed on an employer board today (recruiter posts, aggregator salary figures, and Veepee and Artefact AI-engineer postings that were not opened) were not counted. Shine’s Senior AI Engineer – AI-native SDLC Platform appeared in French search results, but the employer page lists only non-French hubs, so it was not examined further.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10–31 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
Company financial diligence was not advanced because no role was ranked; the Mirakl and Nebius notes are employer-stated only.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. Zero new roles qualified today. Mirakl would need a base salary above €100,000 (or at least €80,000 with explicit equity); Kpler and Nebius would need a published salary and an explicit attendance or France-eligibility rule before reconsideration. No applications or outreach were made.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: “This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.” The application form asks whether the applicant can come to the Paris or Bordeaux offices four days per week.[1]

salary.quote: “Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000”. The range is labelled a package, so base salary is not confirmed, and no equity or BSPCE term is published. Even read as base pay, the €90,000 floor is not above €100,000 and has no stated equity, so it fails the pay rule.[1]

reasons: Pay gate fails as published: the €90,000 lower bound is a “package” figure, is not above €100,000, and comes with no stated equity.[1]
Location passes on employer evidence: Paris (or Bordeaux) with four office days per week, stated on the listing and asked again on the application form.[1]

AI centrality passes: the role is the AI technical lead for one business domain and is asked to “Design and build production-grade AI systems” and to “own the agent product roadmap for your domain”. Part of the job is strategy, adoption and mentoring rather than coding.[1][2]

Seniority passes (Principal; 7+ years). New to this site’s history; first published September 7, 2026 per the official Greenhouse data. The application form rendered on the check date. A Lead AI Engineer requisition (6116425004) on the same board carries the same text and the same €90,000–€100,000 package and is not listed separately.[1][2]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: Mirakl sells an enterprise marketplace platform, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). This role builds AI agents for internal business domains such as Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal, using LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and vector databases.[1]
jobs.financials: Employer-stated on the listing: founded in 2012, member of French Tech Next40, 750+ employees in 9 offices, 450+ marketplaces. Funding, revenue and profitability were not publicly verified in this run.[1]

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling Infrastructure
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: location “Remote, Global”, location type Remote; “We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere.” France is not named.[7]

salary.quote: No salary range is published and the official ATS data has no compensation tier. The listing states “Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company.” Pay is unknown.[7][8]

reasons: AI-engineering gate fails on the employer’s own wording: “It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role.” The duties are running, securing and scaling the services behind Supabase’s AI products, including its MCP server.[7]
Pay is unpublished; equity (ESOP) is stated.[7][8]
Seniority is not stated in the title (5+ years required). New requisition, published October 31, 2026 per the ATS. The application form rendered on the check date.[7][8]
